title: Stained Glass Inferno
description: A crumbling stone archway with a vibrant stained glass window depicting a robed figure stands on the left. To the right, a massive swirling explosion of golden yellow and orange light fragments fills the dark stormy sky above a rocky ground.
prompt: Surreal night scene of an ancient crumbling stone archway with a glowing blue and red stained glass window showing a religious figure on the left side. A massive turbulent explosion of golden yellow and orange glowing fragments and sparks dominates the right side of the image, set against a dark turbulent stormy sky with dramatic clouds and faint stars, rocky debris ground, painterly style with visible brushwork and bokeh light effects
